rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I by AMA, AAPA or AAFP (at least 50); Category II by AMA, AAPA or AAFP (max 50)
rules.alternatives: Passing PANRE or recertifying with NCCPA via PANRE-LA during the reporting period; or a PA master's degree within one year of expiration of an initial license.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Within one year of initial licensure: 3-hour Board-approved course on Risk Assessment and Responsible Prescribing of Controlled Substances (waived if no controlled substances); counts toward the 100 hours.
rules.audit_note: Board may audit; documentation due within 30 days of request. Keep CE records 6 years.

topics.who: PAs who prescribe, administer or dispense controlled substances: within one year of initial licensure

rules.notes: Renewal before April 1 of every odd year. PAs working with DOs are licensed by the WV Board of Osteopathic Medicine (second rule). WV Code 30-1-7a (drug diversion CE) not checked: code site blocked.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code of State Rules 11CSR1B (§11-1B-5, §11-1B-14)
